# S1-07 binary fixture

`sample.mp4` is the small `fixture-isom.mp4` from file-type v22.0.2:
https://github.com/sindresorhus/file-type/blob/v22.0.2/fixture/fixture-isom.mp4

Used only to test signature detection and byte limits. The fixture is not an upload from a user.
